title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, it can potentially fit the training data better. However, this is not always guaranteed. Consider how adding a feature might affect the model's ability to capture the training data's patterns.

title: Effect of Adding a Feature
text: Adding a feature, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, can lead to overfitting. Overfitting occurs when the model captures noise in the training data as if it were a true pattern.

title: Impact on MSE
text: Consider how overfitting might affect the Mean Squared Error (MSE) on the training data. Does it increase or decrease?
